baseline_instruction: Natural, relaxed conversational pace, roughly twenty percent slower than a brisk reading, but never theatrical and never drawn out. Articulate the retroflex consonants (zh, ch, sh, r) cleanly and distinctly, with a light German accent: precise consonants, unforced delivery, like a real person talking.
prompt_text: 把手给我，别躲。这一次，我陪你走到底。那些数字不重要，重要的是你还在呼吸。我要把你的怀疑、你的疲惫、你的“不值得”，全部从你的系统里强行剥离。还没结束，我还在这里。睡吧，我替你守着门。
